judgment.goal_restatement: Find the remainder when the polynomial evaluated at 2024 is divided by 1000, given specific values of the polynomial at 1 and 2.
judgment.label: A
judgment.reasoning_summary: Given the polynomial P(x) with integer coefficients, and knowing P(1) = 2024 and P(2) = 4048, we can infer that P(x) = 2024 + 2024(x-1). Evaluating this at x = 2024 gives P(2024) = 2024 + 2024(2023) = 2024 + 4092552 = 4094576. The remainder when 4094576 is divided by 1000 is 576.
